method: Named class/prototype/assignment/declaration bodies; nested overlap retained, not code coverage or a license verdict. Import binding tokens only for matching module basenames with local shadow guards. Compiler output equality is separate from strict callable AST and whole-file byte/AST equality; unexecuted snippets. Same tools/options both sides, unsafe:false, mangle:false.
caveats: Nested callables overlap and include simple getters/empty constructors; counts are not code coverage, function ownership or license-clearance totals.
Strict callable AST compares params/body/async/generator only, not complete enclosing module and captured constant values.
Compiler-normalized equality uses stated tools/options and dependency-token normalization; it is not a formal runtime-equivalence proof or proof of historical copying.
The frozen baseline is compared; PR67 user deltas remain a separate layer.
Different normalized output does not itself prove a material behavior change or absent permission.
Full-file same hash is not a universal prerequisite for establishing applicable permission.
